title: Clean up landing hero active path marker
summary: Adjusted the landing page hero flow path so the fixed stop dots stay quiet and fade out while the animated signal reaches each step. This removes the doubled-dot visual clash in the active path and keeps the signal glow aligned to the active stage color.
userVisibleChange: The hero animation now shows a single clean active path marker instead of two overlapping dots when a step is active.

risks.title: Animation timing is CSS-keyframe based
risks.mitigation: Verified computed active-dot opacity over the loop and captured a browser screenshot at the affected viewport.

timeline.title: Muted fixed stop dots
timeline.summary: Reduced fixed stop-dot size, removed their halos, and faded each active stop while the moving signal is present.

timeline.title: Matched signal glow to stage
timeline.summary: Kept the moving marker blue through plan/snapshot and green through commit.

timeline.title: Built and browser-verified
timeline.summary: Ran the production build, whitespace check, animation state probe, and screenshot capture.

decisions.title: Make the moving signal the only active marker
decisions.rationale: The visual defect came from the fixed step dot highlighting at the same moment the traveling signal arrived. Keeping stop dots small and hiding them during their active window preserves structure without competing with the animated marker.

decisions.title: Animate signal glow color with the stage
decisions.rationale: The signal now uses blue glow for plan/snapshot phases and green glow for commit, preventing stale color cues at the end of the flow.
